reason: Independent blind protocol audit required a fixed batch size, stronger hash closure, a render-only selection snapshot, runtime processor assertions, and two independent full embedding runs. This addendum preserves rather than overwrites the original pre-result amendment.

snapshot_preflight.contents: Only the exact frozen prompt manifest, identity-bearing candidate inventory, copied eligible 16-view renders addressed by identity SHA-256, copied pinned CLIP model files, summary, and lock.
snapshot_preflight.renders_directory_rule: The directory-name set must exactly equal the identity SHA-256 set of all and only eligible candidates. Each directory must contain exactly 000.png through 015.png.
snapshot_preflight.filesystem_policy: All snapshot files are regular in-workspace copies with source and destination SHA-256 equality; files are chmod 0444 and directories 0555 before the staging directory is atomically renamed.
snapshot_preflight.isolation_claim: Workspace-local read-only copies plus code-audited explicit inputs; not an OS sandbox.

formal_selection.candidate_scope: All snapshot-eligible Artiverse assets; global retrieval without category filtering.
formal_selection.full_replay_requirement: Both complete image embedding matrices, both complete prompt embedding matrices, all tokenization/index metadata, and both top-1 JSONL manifests must be byte-identical/equal. This is a full embedding replay, not only an ordering replay.
formal_selection.selection_tie_break: Descending exact float64 dot-product score, then ascending identity SHA-256, then ascending identity path. No epsilon window.

processor_assertions: CLIP image mean and standard deviation
RGB conversion, resize, crop, and normalization enabled
CLIP BOS, EOS, and PAD token ids
vision image size 224 and patch size 32

independent_pre_result_audit_gate.preservation: The selector preserves both audit files. The final experiment report is result_report.md, so the pre-result report.md is never overwritten.

requirements: Recompute and verify every selection lock file hash.
Verify original amendment, addendum, snapshot builder, selector, and materializer bindings.
Verify the two archive records, full extracted-data counts, snapshot root closure, candidate/eligible/index counts, and exact prompt task set.
Verify both locked asset and prompt embedding matrices are exactly equal across the two runs, finite, unit normalized, and have frozen shapes.
Recompute every 18 by N float64 similarity score and deterministic global top-1 with the frozen tie break before opening geometry.
Only then open the unique selected segmented GLB; use unit scale 1.0, repair 0, and no rank fallback.
materialization_closure.score_replays: Run the frozen structured/count-proxy scorer twice and the frozen numeric scorer twice, requiring byte-identical outputs, then run the frozen integrity verifier.
materialization_closure.report_semantics: Artiverse prompt-only CLIP retrieval is a fixed-dataset reference/retrieval control, not same-prompt generation and not an Artiverse generative method. Numeric pass is the primary constraint metric; named-node exact-count is supplementary proxy only.
